citations.claim: cart position exceeds +2.4m track limit at first violating step
one step before violation cart already near end moving outward at ~1.37 m/s while controller pushes outward

explanation: Shrunk minimal case has no pushes and no sensor noise: heavy pole (0.5kg), high gravity (15), initial theta=0.2/omega=0.5. Controller keeps pole nearly upright (theta~0.05 at step 128) with small positive force ~1.2N, but allows steady cart drift with v~1.27-1.38 m/s from step 120 to 128, driving x from 2.19 to 2.40+. It prioritizes pole balance over cart centering and never brakes/reverses, so cart exits track.

violation.detail: cart at x=2.406 outside the +/-2.4 track

vision_note: The cart drifts steadily to the right toward the end of the track while the pole remains nearly upright. By step 128 the cart reaches the right track limit and goes out of bounds.
